# Stock of the Day: Will AppLovin Break Out of a Flag Pattern?
...
AppLovin Corp.’s (NASDAQ:APP) shares could be about to break out of a ‘flag’ pattern. This could be a bullish dynamic that would suggest a move higher. It’s why the mobile technology and advertising platform is the Stock of the Day.
...
A ‘flag pattern’ illustrates a break in the trend before it kicks back into gear. It is a continuation pattern. One of these may have formed on AppLovin’s chart.

These appear on a chart when the people who are driving the trend, in this case the buyers, believe that they may be the ones who are pushing the price higher. They decide to step out of the market for a few days to see if the price will drop.

Then they can finish their orders at lower prices.

providers.market_view: US equity markets are navigating a transitional phase following early-November technology sector weakness, with violent breadth expansion and sector rotation occurring as capital flows from mega-cap tech into defensive areas and select opportunities. Implied volatility remains relatively muted despite significant index moves, reflecting the offsetting nature of sector rotation. The market is approaching a critical earnings period with major technology reports, but most near-term catalyst-driven momentum has already been realized in the prior week's trading. The environment favors selectivity over broad exposure, with many names having already reacted to their immediate catalysts.

Broad US tape was cautious and defensive at cutoff, with AI-linked stocks under pressure ahead of bellwether chip earnings later in the week, favoring idiosyncratic and defensive longs over broad tech beta.

# 【GTA 6｜TTWO業績】《GTA 6》11月19日如期推出 預訂需求強勁 母公司Take-Two季度營收跌15% 盤後升逾3%
...
發布時間： 12 分鐘前

全球矚目的遊戲大作《Grand Theft Auto VI》（GTA 6，俠盜獵車手6）將於11月19日正式推出。遊戲發行商Take-Two Interactive（美：TTWO）周一（9日）公布2027財年第二季業績，行政總裁Strauss Zelnick確認新作距離推出只剩10日，預訂需求達到前所未見的水平。公司業績公布後盤後服價一度升逾3%。

截至9月底止季度，Take-Two營收按年下跌約15%至14.97億美元，淨訂單額（Net Bookings）下跌18%至16億美元，低於市場預期約16.7億美元。季度淨虧損由去年同期1.339億美元收窄至5,400萬美元，每股虧損由0.73美元減至0.29美元。

## 《GTA 6》倒數10日推出 首推PS5及Xbox版本

Take-Two在最新業績文件確認，《GTA 6》維持11月19日發售，首批支援PlayStation 5及Xbox Series X/S，PC版本暫未公布推出日期。

行政總裁Strauss Zelnick表示，《GTA 6》的預訂需求持續處於前所未見的水平，對公司創下歷史性業績充滿信心。

《GTA 6》是Rockstar Games繼2013年推出《GTA 5》後，時隔13年的系列新作。前作全球累計銷量已超過2.3億套，成為歷來最暢銷的電子遊戲之一。

新作過去曾多次延期，最近一次於2025年11月宣布押後至2026年11月19日。今次業績確認日期不變，為期待已久的玩家帶來好消息。

Johnson & Johnson said on Monday it had agreed to buy Texas-based biotech Ollin Biosciences, expanding its pipeline of eye disease therapies.

Johnson & Johnson will acquire Ollin for $2.2 billion upfront, with the potential for regulatory and commercial milestone payments of up to about $1.13 billion, the drugmaker said.

Ollin, backed by investment firms ARCH Venture Partners and Mubadala Capital, was established in 2023 to develop treatments for vision-threatening diseases.

The deal is expected to close before the end of 2026.

# Johnson & Johnson to Buy Ollin Biosciences for $2.2 Billion

## Asset manager Blackstone will fund development of Ollin’s lead asset

Johnson & Johnson JNJ 0.79%increase; up pointing triangle has agreed to buy Ollin Biosciences, a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing therapies for serious eye diseases, for an initial $2.2 billion, and has struck a deal with asset manager Blackstone to fund development of Ollin’s lead asset.

J&J on Monday said the Ollin deal, which includes more than $1.12 billion in potential regulatory and commercial milestone payments, adds OLN324, an investigational bispecific antibody for retinal vascular diseases, including wet age-related macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema.
